retrograde_planets.name: Mercury Retrograde
retrograde_planets.meaning: A time of delays, technical glitches and revisited agreements. Ideal for correcting mistakes, tidying up archives and returning to unfinished old business. Unfavorable for signing contracts and buying gadgets.

retrograde_planets.name: Venus Retrograde
retrograde_planets.meaning: A period of reassessing personal bonds and financial strategies. People from the past may return. It is not advisable to marry, change your look radically or make large investments.

retrograde_planets.name: Mars Retrograde
retrograde_planets.meaning: Outer momentum drops, and projects feel stuck in place. Do not start an aggressive competitive fight or a risky new venture; it is better to focus on auditing your current strategy.

retrograde_planets.name: Jupiter Retrograde
retrograde_planets.meaning: A rethinking of life values and a search for inner authorities in place of outer ones. A good time for deep study and for revising your plans for the future.

retrograde_planets.name: Saturn Retrograde
retrograde_planets.meaning: A test of the strength of your life foundations. A time to return to old professional commitments, correct systemic errors and strengthen your personal boundaries.

retrograde_planets.name: Uranus Retrograde
retrograde_planets.meaning: An inner transformation of your attitude toward personal freedom and technology. A time to rethink rebellious ideas and to integrate what is new without chaos.

retrograde_planets.name: Neptune Retrograde
retrograde_planets.meaning: Old illusions dissolve and the “rose-colored glasses” come off. A period of healing from creative crises and of reassessing spiritual bearings.

retrograde_planets.name: Pluto Retrograde
retrograde_planets.meaning: Work with subconscious fears, psychological blocks and inner crises. A time of release from outworn beliefs.
